candidates.angle: bahi and antah, outside and inside
subtlety means it cannot be known
candidates.evidence: सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं (because it is subtle, it is not knowable)

candidates.angle: far and near at the same time

angle_en: Bahi and antah, outside and inside

en.intro: Krishna just said the supreme reality is beyond the senses, yet Krishna now says it is inside and outside all beings.
en.notice: Listen to the word bahi, outside, and antah, inside. It fills everything, yet because it is so subtle, it cannot be known, and it is far away and near at the same time.
en.next: Krishna now says this undivided reality appears divided among all beings, and that it creates and devours them.
en.meaning: The supreme reality is inside and outside all beings, moving and unmoving. Because it is subtle, it cannot be known; it is far away and near at hand.

hi.intro: कृष्ण ने पहले कहा कि परमात्मा इन्द्रियों से परे है, फिर भी अब वे कहते हैं कि वह सभी प्राणियों के बाहर और भीतर है।
hi.meaning: वे परमात्मा सम्पूर्ण प्राणियों के बाहर भी और भीतर भी हैं। वे चराचर हैं और अत्यन्त सूक्ष्म होने के कारण उन्हें जानना संभव नहीं है। वे दूर भी हैं और पास भी।
hi.notice: बाहिर और भीतर, ये शब्द सुनिए। यह सब कुछ भर देता है, फिर भी बहुत सूक्ष्म होने के कारण इसे जाना नहीं जा सकता और यह दूर भी है और पास भी।
hi.next: कृष्ण अब कहते हैं कि यह अविभाज्य परमात्मा प्राणियों में विभक्त सा प्रतीत होता है और वही सब को धारण करता है, खाता है और बनाता है।

en.intro: Krishna just said the supreme reality is beyond the senses, yet Krishna now says it is inside and outside all beings.
en.body: The supreme reality is inside and outside all beings, moving and unmoving. Because it is subtle, it cannot be known; it is far away and near at hand. Listen to the word bahi, outside, and antah, inside. It fills everything, yet because it is so subtle, it cannot be known, and it is far away and near at the same time.
